name: scapula push-up
description: A scapular push-up, protracting and retracting the shoulder blades. Strengthens the serratus anterior and upper back.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Keep your elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Let your chest sink between your shoulder blades as they squeeze together.
Push the floor away to spread your shoulder blades apart, rounding your upper back slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
